_about: Lines said during a fight, by map id (MapStage runBattleLines): each once a fight, between actions, by its speaker while it stands. when: battleStart | bossRegenerates | allyBadlyWounded (below, default 0.3) | bossNearDefeat (below, default 0.25).

wisp-forest-crossing-boss.speaker: Salazar
wisp-forest-crossing-boss.text: Queimem o caule principal! As raízes vão continuar crescendo se vocês não destruírem o coração!

translations.en: Burn the main stalk! The roots will keep growing unless you destroy the heart!

wisp-forest-crossing-boss.speaker: Salazar
wisp-forest-crossing-boss.text: Ali! Estão vendo como ela se alimenta? Fogo nela antes que se recupere!

translations.en: There! See how it feeds itself? Give it fire before it recovers!

wisp-forest-crossing-boss.speaker: Salazar
wisp-forest-crossing-boss.text: Fique parado! Ninguém morre sob os meus cuidados!

translations.en: Hold still! You're not dying on my watch!

wisp-forest-crossing-boss.speaker: Salazar
wisp-forest-crossing-boss.text: É isso! Mantenham as chamas nela!

translations.en: That's it! Keep the flames on it!
